data.body: Gerrit 1589 patch set 1 earned LLM-Review +1 with two non-blocking advisories. Remediated both rather than defer: (1) added a RED schema-contract test for integer/null/object reverse-index targets, then normalized corrupt diagnostic IDs so every store_integrity finding validates against the published schema; (2) added RED grep/show timeout tests, then applied the established 120-second fsck Git timeout and translated both timeout paths to RebarError(returncode=2). The initial timeout branches exposed a new C901 finding, so exception translation was extracted into one shared helper and the complexity ratchet returned to active=66/new=0/increased=0/stale=0. Final focused results: 27/27 integrity tests, 133/133 changed-surface tests, lint, typecheck, and diff check all green.
